Brickspect is an automated vision-based defect detection system developed by KSM Vision, a company based in Warsaw, Poland. It is designed for manufacturers of building materials, particularly those producing paving blocks and hollow bricks. The system utilizes vision cameras and machine learning algorithms to effectively identify and remove defects in bricks or blocks during the production process. ([ksmvision.com](https://ksmvision.com/solution/brickspect-quality-control-of-paving-and-hollow-bricks/?utm_source=openai))

The primary functions of Brickspect include:

- **Defect Detection**: Automatically identifying surface defects such as cracks, discolorations, and other imperfections on the upper surface of paving stones and blocks.

- **Height Control**: Measuring the height of products to ensure they meet specified dimensions, utilizing laser triangulation algorithms for precise analysis.

By implementing Brickspect, manufacturers can address labor shortages by automating the inspection process, thereby enhancing product quality and consistency. The system also offers a user-friendly touch panel interface that provides visual presentations of inspection results, centralized control over product quality, and the capability to generate reports, trend analyses, and alarms. ([ksmvision.com](https://ksmvision.com/solution/brickspect-quality-control-of-paving-and-hollow-bricks/?utm_source=openai))

KSM Vision, founded in 2012 by Marcin Malesa and Krzysztof Malowany, specializes in automated machine vision inspection systems for quality control across various industries, including construction, pharmaceuticals, and wood processing. ([thecompanycheck.com](https://www.thecompanycheck.com/company/b/ksm-vision/13kj07olnmd3ao9vo?utm_source=openai))
